articles.title: Caribbean nations fear economic impact of shuttering citizenship program after EU threats
articles.highlight: 圣基茨和尼维斯总理宣布将逐步终止投资入籍计划，此前欧盟威胁取消免签待遇。
articles.summary: 圣基茨和尼维斯在欧盟威胁取消免签待遇后，决定逐步终止以投资换取公民身份的项目。尼维斯总理警告，该项目收入对当地经济和扶助有需要人群至关重要。这则国际新闻值得关注，因为它显示小国护照计划在外部合规压力下的取舍。

articles.sourceExcerpt: St Kitts and Nevis to wind down citizenship-by-investment program after EU warns of end to visa-free access The decision by St Kitts and Nevis to end a lucrative programme offering citizenship to wealthy foreigners in exchange for investment threatens its economy and ability to support people in need, the premier of the island of Nevis has warned. On Friday, Terrance Drew, the prime minister of the twin-island Caribbean nation, announced he would wind down the citizenship-by-investment (CBI) programme, after the European Union threatened to end visa-free access for St Kitts and Nevis.

articles.title: Love Anyway
articles.highlight: 明知生命的代价是死亡、爱的代价是失去，你仍凝望金色午后落在一张深爱的脸上，并依然去爱。
articles.summary: 文章从“爱即便终将失去仍值得付出”的命题出发，借路易丝·厄德里奇《彩绘鼓》的段落，讨论生命必朽与爱的短暂如何并存。它值得读，是因为把死亡的必然与爱的选择放在同一视野中，提醒人仍可在有限中投入地去爱。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心提醒是：爱的价值并不取决于它能否永久留存，而在于明知会失去仍选择去爱；这是一种清醒而非天真的生活态度。
articles.sourceExcerpt: You know that the price of life is death, that the price of love is loss, and still you watch the golden afternoon light fall on a face you love, knowing that the light will soon fade, knowing that the loving face too will one day fade to indifference or bone, and you love anyway — because life is transient but possible, because love alone bridges the impossible and the eternal. I think about this and a passage from Louise Erdrich’s 2005 novel The Painted Drum (public library) flits across the sky of my mind: Life will break you.

en.highlight: You know that the price of life is death, that the price of love is loss, and still you watch the golden afternoon light fall on a face you love.
en.summary: The piece reflects on the fact that life ends in death and love in loss, yet we still choose to love what is transient. Drawing on a passage from Louise Erdrich’s The Painted Drum, it is worth reading for its clear-eyed reminder that finitude does not make love pointless.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that love’s value does not depend on permanence; it lies in choosing to love while knowing loss is inevitable—a clear-eyed rather than naive stance.

articles.title: External sandboxes for coding agents
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: Expert analysis
articles.summary: Simon Willison 与 Prime Radiant 合作介绍外部沙箱模式：代理在沙箱外运行，需执行的代码被送进独立沙箱。团队发布了基于 v86、Apple Containers 和 Quicksand 的三种服务实现，并提供统一的 localhost API、HTTP/HTTPS 允许列表代理和凭据替换机制。对希望安全试用本地模型、降低提示注入造成破坏风险的非技术读者，这有助于理解“隔离执行”为何是代理安全的关键边界。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键不在于让模型永不犯错，而在于用沙箱限制错误可造成的实际影响；允许列表和凭据替换进一步缩小网络与密钥暴露面。
articles.highlight: 外部沙箱模式让代理执行的代码运行在专用沙箱内，而代理本身留在沙箱之外。
articles.sourceExcerpt: External sandboxes for coding agents I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine. I worked on this project with Prime Radiant , the AI research lab behind Superpowers and other projects . My post on the Prime Radiant blog introduces the external sandbox pattern, where code executed by the agent runs inside a dedicated sandbox while the agent itself lives outside of that sandbox.

en.highlight: The external sandbox pattern runs agent-executed code inside a dedicated sandbox while the agent itself lives outside that sandbox.
en.summary: Simon Willison and Prime Radiant introduce an external sandbox pattern in which the agent runs outside a dedicated sandbox while its code executes inside it. They released three implementations—v86, Apple Containers, and Quicksand—with a shared localhost API, an HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy, and credential replacement. It is worth reading for a concrete way to test local models with less risk from mistakes or prompt injection.
en.failureAnalysis: The key is not making the model infallible but limiting the real-world impact of its mistakes through isolation; allow-lists and credential replacement further reduce network and secret exposure.
